name: Faith Healing
overview: Scripture teaches that God is the ultimate healer, promising protection from disease to those who obey His commandments, as seen in Exodus 15:26. The healing of believers is deeply connected to the atoning work of Christ, who was wounded and bruised so that we might be healed, according to Isaiah 53:5. Additionally, healing is portrayed as an act of divine mercy and restoration, with Jeremiah 17:14 expressing a heartfelt plea for the Lord's healing and salvation, affirming that true healing comes from God alone.
